notes:
Quick CRM notes / shorthand. Mid-market product-analytics SaaS (B2B) evaluating Redwood for conversational product assistant and semantic search. Started with Hosted API trial (sandbox + low-volume production routes). Trial metrics summary (hosted): avg sustained QPS 6, typical concurrency 12, observed daily peak QPS 28 (short campaign on 2026-02-19). Token mix during trial: ~62% requests <=256 tokens (quick prompts/reprompting), ~30% in 256-2048 token range (contextual search + multi-turn), ~8% >2048 (long document summarization). Average tokens per request: generation 420 tokens, prompt/context 780 tokens for long flows. Streaming vs non-streaming: ~45% streaming (chat UI), 55% non-streaming (batch embedding/rerank).

POC ask: produce Dedicated capacity sizing + traffic forecast for expected go-live (Q3). Customer expects 75% traffic growth from trial to prod, with sustained QPS target ~15 and burst tolerance to 120 QPS during peak campaigns. Concurrency target for Dedicated: support 40 concurrent streaming sessions with average generation length 600 tokens, and handle up to 200 embedding requests/sec (short token payloads).

SE recommendations so far (initial, not final): start with 2x8-GPU A10 pool as baseline for baseline low-latency chat and embeddings; autoscale to 6-8 GPUs for bursts. Suggest model variants: quantized 8-bit for embeddings/rerank to save cost; FP16 or mixed-precision for chat heavy routes. Suggested routing policy: primary to Dedicated (low-latency) with fallback to Hosted API for region overflow.

Pricing sensitivity: wants < $0.20 per 1k gen tokens equivalent on average; looking for predictable committed spend (prefers monthly Reservation or annual). Root blockers: finance wants committed ARR band and exact cost model, security still needs VPC peering diagram and HSM/KMS details. Integration notes: SSO test failed on first try (SAML assertion nameID mismatch) — Rohit coordinating with their SRE. Quote from product lead on call: "We need predictable tail latency under 300ms for 90% of chat responses to keep UI feeling snappy."
use_case_requirements_summary: workload types: chat + embeddings + reranking. latency target: 90p < 300ms for short prompts, p95 < 800ms for long-context. throughput target: sustained QPS 15, bursts to 120. concurrency target: 40 streaming sessions. cost sensitivity: mid-market, prefers committed tier to control unit economics.
capacity_forecast_high_level: From hosted trial logs + growth assumptions: baseline sustained QPS = 15, avg tokens/sec ~ 9k (gen+context aggregated). Peak burst model: 120 QPS with average generation 600 tokens => peak token/sec ~72k. Recommended Dedicated sizing: baseline 2x8-GPU A10-equivalent pool with autoscale to 6-8 GPUs for campaign peaks; reserve burst capacity window and routing fallback to Hosted API.
